environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but on Ubuntu 22.04 nodes with AppArmor enabled. Pod annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/stream-processor=localhost/stream-proc-cache-only applies a custom AppArmor profile. The profile (loaded via apparmor_parser at node bootstrap) specifies: deny /** rw, /var/cache/stream-processor/resources/** r, /proc/self/status r, /dev/null rw, network inet stream, capability net_bind_service. The profile uses 'deny' as default stance with explicit allowlist. Path traversal attempts resolve to paths outside /var/cache/stream-processor/resources/ which are blocked by the MAC deny rule. Note: the profile does NOT use 'owner' qualifier so it applies regardless of DAC permissions.

config.apparmor_profile_rules: profile stream-proc-cache-only flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) { deny /** rw, /var/cache/stream-processor/resources/** r, /var/cache/stream-processor/resources/ r, /proc/self/status r, /dev/null rw, /usr/bin/stream-processor ix, network inet stream, capability net_bind_service, }
